capabilities: Convert Markdown notes or selections to WeChat-compatible HTML
Copy rich-text HTML to the clipboard
disambiguation: Not a general site or blog publisher; the main action is copying styled HTML to the clipboard, with WeChat draft upload only as an optional Pro feature.
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); iOS and Android are not supported. Install and usage instructions live in the GitHub repository at docs/install-guide.md.
problem: Notes written in Markdown need to be pasted into the WeChat Official Account editor as styled HTML rather than plain text.
summary: Desktop-only plugin that converts a Markdown note or selection into WeChat Official Account-styled HTML, with live preview and clipboard copy.
